name: Suntory
h1: New structures, new leaders, one connected way of working
lede: Suntory created a President's Office and Sales Management Department in January 2026, alongside leadership changes at Suntory Beverage and Food and Suntory Global Spirits. New units are the best time to avoid inheriting spreadsheet sprawl.
why_p: New coordinating units and new leaders across the group mean plans, metrics and ownership are being re-baselined now.

signals.title: President's Office and Sales Management Department
signals.body: A reorganisation effective 1 January 2026 created a President's Office and a Sales Management Department, bringing Off-Premise Sales Management, Business Planning and Nationwide Wholesale Account Sales under it.
signals.angle: Coordinating units starting from a blank operating model can begin on a connected work layer.

signals.title: CEO transition at Suntory Beverage and Food
signals.body: Josuke Kimura was appointed director and executive vice president of Suntory Holdings from 1 January 2026, to become President and CEO of Suntory Beverage and Food by late March 2026, succeeding Makiko Ono.
signals.angle: Leadership transitions are when teams re-baseline plans, metrics and ownership.

signals.title: International leadership at Suntory Global Spirits
signals.body: Carol Robert was appointed President, International, at Suntory Global Spirits, effective 1 April 2026.
signals.angle: Global brand and market plans align faster when every region works from the same shared view.
